text: IIT Kanpur invites tenders for housekeeping services. Rs. 94,54,421/- for a period of 01 Year, extendable yearly up to a period of 02 more years, subject to satisfactory performance.

Time allowed for completion of the work shall be Twelve (12) months (extendable yearly up to two more years) from the date of start as defined in Schedule 'F' or from the first date of handing over of the site, whichever is later.

Time allowed for carrying out the work will be 12 Months (365 days) from the date of start as defined in schedule 'F' or from the first date of handing over of the site, whichever is later. The tenure of the contract agreement may be extended further up to twelve (12) months.

The contract will be for periods of one year from 15th June'2022 to 14th May'2023 or one year from the date of acceptance of award of contract, whichever is earlier, and may be extended on mutual consent for a further period of one more year.

Bidders must submit copies of contracts/work orders and documentary evidence of successful execution of similar services for a period of last three years in support of Past Experience of Similar Services.
Standard Delivery Period (DP) for Buyers is 180 days without CA approval & 365 days by uploading CA approval.
Performance Guarantee shall remain valid for a period of 1 year 6 months initially. In case the contract period is extended further, validity of the PBG shall also be required to be extended.
The last date of Tender No. CIPET:CSTS/ABD/CCTV CAMERA/2018/16 for submission of bids is hereby extended up to 07.01.2019. All other Terms & Conditions of the tender remain same.
This corrigendum clarifies the applicable minimum-wage authority for the security-services NIT and extends the last date for receipt of tender by two weeks.
This corrigendum revises the contract period of the AMC agreement; the duration is hereby extended by 6 months due to delayed handover.
The contract shall be awarded for an initial period, structured as 1+1 years based on satisfactory performance review at the end of year one.
The contract shall commence on 25 day of October 2022 for an initial period, with an option to extend by 1 period of 6 months; the contract shall not surpass 23 April 2025.
